run_executeCommand: run a shell command with optional timeout and capture stdout, stderr, and exit code
run_capture: run a shell command and capture its standard output, raising on non-zero exit
run_which: run a lookup for a command name in PATH and return its absolute path
create_guardedTempFilename: create a temporary file that is automatically cleaned up on scope exit
run_executeCommandVerbose: run a shell command and print a detailed report to stderr on failure
